text.description_html:
Fusion B-EL-E4, Rustic Italian Sonoma Rose Doorbell Buttons

Fusion Hardware's Sonoma Collection Doorbell features a squared rose for the rustic, Northern Italy appearance that has become the trademark style of the Sonoma wine country. It is made out of solid brass and is available in a medium bronze, oil rubbed bronze, or an antique pewter finish. It comes packaged with the mounting screws necessary as well as with a lighted doorbell actuator.

Please Note This is a replacement trim only. It comes packaged with lighted button, rosette, and installation screws. It DOES NOT include the chime.

Specifications of the Sonoma Square Doorbell Fusion E4:

  • Length: 2-5/8" square
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Includes lighted button.
  • Packaged as a kit with matching finish installation screws and a lighted button.

Sold Individually
